derivation.method: Authored from the pinned Steel Compendium only (canonical checkout at the main repo vendor/steel-compendium, HEAD fb83a789da8f0327a389c277a0c790b1648d5810 verified with git rev-parse, equal to the v100 compendiumRevision). Expected values are handwritten arithmetic from cited passages; no implementation code under shared/evaluate, shared/content/classes, shared/content/character-decisions.ts, convex or scripts/headless was read or run. Baselines are the reviewed v100 level-one witnesses.
derivation.staminaMaximum: class/conduit.md Basics: Starting Stamina 18, Stamina Gained at 2nd and Higher Levels 6. The Conduit has no kit. Prayer of Steel +6 Stamina (feature/conduit/level-1/prayer-of-steel.md; increases only at 4th, 7th, 10th). Prayer of Soldier's Skill +3 Stamina only while wearing light armor: inactive, following the v100 convention that equipment effects are inactive (uncertainty soldiers-skill-armor). L2 = 24 (30 with Steel); L3 = 30 (36 with Steel).
derivation.recoveryValue: floor(Stamina maximum / 3) (rule/health/recoveries.md "one-third of their Stamina maximum, rounded down")
derivation.noNumericSheetChange: EXPLICIT: no level-2 or level-3 Conduit feature changes a numeric sheet value. The Lists of Heaven (extra Recovery spend when you let another creature spend one), Perk, 2nd-Level Domain Feature (second domain's 1st-level feature + skill), 2nd-Level Domain Ability, Minor Miracle (respite resurrection; you regain only half your Recoveries at the end of that respite) and the 7-Piety Ability are all actions or situational/manual. Of the second-domain features actually gained, Revitalizing Ritual's bonus to recovery value equal to your level (2 at L2, 3 at L3) applies only to a character chosen at the end of a respite until the next respite, so it is NOT folded into the static recoveryValue; Hands of the Maker, Grave Speech, Oracular Visions and Blessing of Comprehension have no numeric sheet effect. None of the chosen perks has a numeric sheet effect. The only numeric changes are the level-driven Stamina +6 per level and the derived recovery/winded values. Speed, stability, disengage, saving-throw threshold, characteristics, potency and recoveries stay at v100 values.
derivation.abilityCounts: Advancement table: level 2 adds one domain ability (Abilities column unchanged: two signature, 3, 5; Domain Abilities 5); level 3 adds one 7-piety ability (Abilities two signature, 3, 5, 7; Domain Abilities 5).
derivation.secondDomainFeature: feature/conduit/level-2/2nd-level-domain-feature.md: gain the 1st-level domain feature and the ability to choose a skill for the domain selected at 1st level whose feature was not taken, i.e. the OTHER chosen domain. Feature and skill group per feature/conduit/level-1/1st-level-domain-feature.md table.
derivation.domainAbilityChoice: feature/conduit/level-2/2nd-level-domain-ability.md: choose one of your domains, gain its table ability. Every witness chooses its level-one feature domain, so all twelve abilities are covered once.
derivation.ability7Choice: Cycled in v100 witness order: Fear of the Gods, Saint's Raiment, Soul Siphon, Words of Wrath and Grace (repeat).
derivation.abilityDamage: "X + I" adds the Intuition score (every witness I2). Prayer of Destruction +1 to rolled damage with magic abilities applied where the witness has that prayer (v100-creation, v100-love, v100-trickery) and the ability has the Magic keyword (all sixteen do), including non-Strike area abilities, matching the v100 method. No kit exists. Sanctified Weapon (v100-war) applies only to abilities that use the blessed weapon; Prayer of Soldier's Skill +1 only to weapon abilities; neither applies.
derivation.distance: Prayer of Distance (v100-death, v100-nature, v100-war) +2 to the distance of ranged magic abilities: Ranged 10 -> Ranged 12; "3 cube within 10" -> "3 cube within 12" by interpretation (uncertainty prayer-of-distance-area-within). Bursts/auras have no Ranged keyword and are unchanged.
derivation.potency: Conduit potency weak I-2 / average I-1 / strong I = 0/1/2 with Intuition 2 (class/conduit.md; rule/character/potency.md).
derivation.perkChoice: One distinct eligible crafting/lore/supernatural perk per witness, none with sub-choices, none already owned (every base owns only Teamwork, an exploration perk).
derivation.secondDomainSkillChoice: One skill per witness from the other domain's skill group, not already held (held = v100 expected skills).

uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: Nature Judges Thee (Area, Magic, Ranged; "3 cube within 10") for v100-nature resolves to "3 cube within 12", cube size unchanged. Only affects displayed distance, not any tested damage value.

uncertainties.resolution: Treated as inactive (no equipment), matching the reviewed v100 baseline (Stamina 18). Expected L2 24 / L3 30.
alternatives: If light armor is modelled as worn: L2 27 (recovery 9, winded 13), L3 33 (recovery 11, winded 16).

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/conduit/level-1/revitalizing-ritual.md "bonus to their recovery value equal to your level that lasts until you finish another respite" (gained at L2 by v100-creation, v100-nature, v100-war).

alternatives: An app that tracks the active ritual target could show recoveryValue + level on the chosen character.

uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: the Effect names the source of the tier-gated frightened condition; frightened is applied only when the potency check succeeds.

automaticFeatures.name: Minor Miracle
automaticFeatures.summary: Respite activity: restore to life a creature dead within 24 hours (not age), with at least half its remains and a willing soul; it returns with full Stamina and half its Recoveries, and you regain only half your Recoveries at the end of that respite.

Statue of Power.name: Statue of Power
effectsPlain: **Effect:** A size 2 statue rises out of the ground in an unoccupied space within distance and lasts until the end of the encounter. While within 3 squares of the statue, you gain 1 surge at the start of each of your turns. Each ally within 3 squares of the statue gains this same benefit. The statue is destroyed if it takes 20 or more damage. It has immunity all to poison and psychic damage.
